headline: Dangote Refinery IPO Faces Record Global Demand
summary: African and retail investors have met the fundraising target for the Dangote Refinery IPO, with demand from 119 countries threatening to exceed available shares.
why: Dangote Refinery is a massive petroleum and petrochemical processing facility in Nigeria, making its public listing a major milestone for African capital markets.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: High international and local demand for the refinery's IPO highlights increased investor confidence in Nigerian assets.

why_moved: Overwhelming global participation in a major emerging-market offering draws significant capital inflows.
